name: tree-sitter-tcsh
description: Tree-sitter grammar for documented tcsh/csh surface syntax.

scripts.check: npm run generate && npm test && npm run check:coverage-matrix && npm run check:coverage-matrix:release && npm run check:no-error && npm run check:queries && npm run check:c-compile
scripts.check:queries: npm exec -- tree-sitter query --grammar-path . --quiet queries/highlights.scm examples/sample.tcsh && npm exec -- tree-sitter query --grammar-path . --quiet queries/locals.scm examples/sample.tcsh && npm exec -- tree-sitter query --grammar-path . --quiet queries/tags.scm examples/sample.tcsh
